name: Recipe Search
author: Glutoblop
description: Adds a fuzzy search box above the crafting recipe list so you can find any recipe by typing part of its name.

changelog.0.2.2: Mod Settings button in the pause menu: change this plugin's settings in game (one tab per plugin).
changelog.0.2.0: Fuzzy recipe search box above the crafting list, optional prefab-name matching, craftable-first sorting.
